people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

people.name: Zedekiah
people.line: Last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile

translations.web: but the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
